item.title: Hadith of the Day: Sahih al-Bukhari 1933 | Authentic Hadith in English
item.description: Narrated Narrated Abu Huraira: "The Prophet ﷺ said, “If somebody eats or drinks forgetfully then he should complete his fast, for what he has eaten or drunk, has been given to him by Allah”" (Sahih al-Bukhari 1933, meaning). Authentic hadith of Prophet Muhammad ﷺ in English.

item.title: Sahih Bukhari Hadith 1930 in Urdu | Hadees in Urdu
item.description: عائشہ رضی اللہ عنہا نے کہا رمضان میں فجر کے وقت نبی کریم ﷺ احتلام سے نہیں (بلکہ اپنی ازواج کے ساتھ صحبت کرنے کی وجہ سے) غسل کرتے اور روزہ رکھتے تھے۔ (معلوم ہوا کہ غسل جنابت روزہ دار فجر کے بعد کر سکتا ہے)۔ (صحیح بخاری 1930). Hadees in Urdu, authentic hadith of Prophet Muhammad ﷺ with Urdu translation. (At times) in Ramadan the Prophet ﷺ used to take a bath in the morning not because of a wet dream and would continue his fast.

item.title: Hadith of the Day: Sahih al-Bukhari 1930 | Authentic Hadith in English
item.description: Narrated Narrated ‘Aisha: "(At times) in Ramadan the Prophet ﷺ used to take a bath in the morning not because of a wet dream and would continue his fast." (Sahih al-Bukhari 1930, meaning). Authentic hadith of Prophet Muhammad ﷺ in English.

item.title: Sahih Bukhari Hadith 1927 in Urdu | Hadees in Urdu
item.description: نبی کریم ﷺ روزہ سے ہوتے لیکن (اپنی ازواج کے ساتھ) «یقبل» (بوسہ لینا) و مباشرت (اپنے جسم سے لگا لینا) بھی کر لیتے تھے۔ نبی کریم ﷺ تم سب سے زیادہ اپنی خواہشات پر قابو رکھنے والے تھے، بیان کیا کہ ابن عباس رضی اللہ عنہما نے کہا کہ (سورۃ طہٰ میں جو «مآرب‏» کا لفظ ہے وہ) حاجت و ضرورت کے معنی میں ہے، طاؤس نے کہا کہ لفظ «أولی الإربة‏» (جو سورۃ النور میں ہے) اس احمق کو کہیں گے جسے عورتوں کی کوئی ضرورت نہ ہو۔ (صحیح بخاری 1927). item.title: Hadith of the Day: Sahih al-Bukhari 1927 | Authentic Hadith in English
item.description: Narrated Narrated ‘Aisha: "The Prophet ﷺ used to kiss and embrace (his wives) while he was fasting, and he had more power to control his desires than any of you. Said Jabir, “The person who gets discharge after casting a look (on his wife) should complete his fast”" (Sahih al-Bukhari 1927, meaning). Authentic hadith of Prophet Muhammad ﷺ in English.

item.title: Hadith of the Day: Sahih al-Bukhari 1924 | Authentic Hadith in English
item.description: Narrated Narrated Salama bin Al-Akwa‘: "Once the Prophet ﷺ ordered a person on ‘Ashura’ (the tenth of Muharram) to announce, “Whoever has eaten, should not eat any more, but fast, and who has not eaten should not eat, but complete his fast (till the end of the day)”" (Sahih al-Bukhari 1924, meaning). Authentic hadith of Prophet Muhammad ﷺ in English.

item.title: Sahih Bukhari Hadith 1922 in Urdu | Hadees in Urdu
item.description: نبی کریم ﷺ نے ”صوم وصال“ رکھا تو صحابہ رضی اللہ عنہم نے بھی رکھا لیکن صحابہ رضی اللہ عنہم کے لیے دشواری ہو گئی۔ اس لیے آپ ﷺ نے اس سے منع فرما دیا، صحابہ رضی اللہ عنہم نے اس پر عرض کی کہ آپ ﷺ صوم وصال رکھتے ہیں؟ نبی کریم ﷺ نے فرمایا میں تمہاری طرح نہیں ہوں۔ میں تو برابر کھلایا اور پلایا جاتا ہوں۔ (صحیح بخاری 1922). item.title: Hadith of the Day: Sahih al-Bukhari 1922 | Authentic Hadith in English
item.description: Narrated Narrated ‘Abdullah: "The Prophet ﷺ fasted for days continuously; the people also did the same but it was difficult for them. So, the Prophet ﷺ forbade them (to fast continuously for more than one day). They said, “But you fast without break (no food was taken in the evening or in the morning).” The Prophet ﷺ replied, “I am not like you, for I am provided with food and drink (by Allah)”" (Sahih al-Bukhari 1922, meaning). Authentic hadith of Prophet Muhammad ﷺ in English.

item.title: Sahih Bukhari Hadith 1921 in Urdu | Hadees in Urdu

item.title: Hadith of the Day: Sahih al-Bukhari 1921 | Authentic Hadith in English
item.description: Narrated Narrated Anas: "Zaid bin Thabit said, “We took the Suhur with the Prophet ﷺ. Then he stood for the prayer.” I asked, “What was the interval between the Suhur and the Adhan?” He replied, “The interval was sufficient to recite fifty verses of the Qur’an”" (Sahih al-Bukhari 1921, meaning). Authentic hadith of Prophet Muhammad ﷺ in English.

item.title: Sahih Bukhari Hadith 1920 in Urdu | Hadees in Urdu
item.description: میں سحری اپنے گھر کھاتا پھر جلدی کرتا تاکہ نماز نبی کریم ﷺ کے ساتھ مل جائے۔ (صحیح بخاری 1920). Hadees in Urdu, authentic hadith of Prophet Muhammad ﷺ with Urdu translation. I used to take my Suhur meals with my family and then hurry up for presenting myself for the (Fajr) prayer with Allah’s Messenger ﷺ.

item.title: Hadith of the Day: Sahih al-Bukhari 1920 | Authentic Hadith in English
item.description: Narrated Narrated Sahl bin Sa‘d: "I used to take my Suhur meals with my family and then hurry up for presenting myself for the (Fajr) prayer with Allah’s Messenger ﷺ." (Sahih al-Bukhari 1920, meaning). Authentic hadith of Prophet Muhammad ﷺ in English.

item.title: Hadith of the Day: Sahih al-Bukhari 1915 | Authentic Hadith in English
item.description: Narrated Narrated Al-Bara: "It was the custom among the companions of Muhammad ﷺ that if any of them was fasting and the food was presented (for breaking his fast), but he slept before eating, he would not eat that night and the following day till sunset. item.title: Hadith of the Day: Sahih al-Bukhari 1914 | Authentic Hadith in English
item.description: Narrated Narrated Abu Huraira: "The Prophet ﷺ said, “None of you should fast a day or two before the month of Ramadan unless he has the habit of fasting (Nawafil) (and if his fasting coincides with that day) then he can fast that day”" (Sahih al-Bukhari 1914, meaning). Authentic hadith of Prophet Muhammad ﷺ in English.

item.title: Hadith of the Day: Sahih al-Bukhari 1913 | Authentic Hadith in English
item.description: Narrated Narrated Ibn ‘Umar: "The Prophet ﷺ said, “We are an illiterate nation; we neither write, nor know accounts. The month is like this and this, i.e. sometimes of 29 days and sometimes of thirty days”" (Sahih al-Bukhari 1913, meaning). Authentic hadith of Prophet Muhammad ﷺ in English.

item.description: Narrated Narrated Ibn ‘Umar: "The Prophet ﷺ said, “The month is like this and this,” (at the same time he showed the fingers of both his hands thrice) and left out one thumb on the third time." (Sahih al-Bukhari 1908, meaning). Authentic hadith of Prophet Muhammad ﷺ in English.

item.title: Hadith of the Day: Sahih al-Bukhari 1906 | Authentic Hadith in English
item.description: Narrated Narrated ‘Abdullah bin ‘Umar: "Allah’s Messenger ﷺ mentioned Ramadan and said, “Do not fast unless you see the crescent (of Ramadan), and do not give up fasting till you see the crescent (of Shawwal), but if the sky is overcast (if you cannot see it), then act on estimation (i.e. count Sha’ban as 30 days)”" (Sahih al-Bukhari 1906, meaning). Authentic hadith of Prophet Muhammad ﷺ in English.

item.title: Sahih Bukhari Hadith 1905 in Urdu | Hadees in Urdu

item.title: Hadith of the Day: Sahih al-Bukhari 1905 | Authentic Hadith in English
item.description: Narrated Narrated ‘Alqama: "While I was walking with ‘Abdullah he said, “We were in the company of the Prophet ﷺ and he said, ‘He who can afford to marry should marry, because it will help him refrain from looking at other women, and save his private parts from committing illegal sexual relation; and he who cannot afford to marry is advised to fast, as fasting will diminish his sexual power”" (Sahih al-Bukhari 1905, meaning). Authentic hadith of Prophet Muhammad ﷺ in English.

item.title: Sahih Bukhari Hadith 1902 in Urdu | Hadees in Urdu
item.description: عبداللہ بن عباس رضی اللہ عنہما نے کہا نبی کریم ﷺ سخاوت اور خیر کے معاملہ میں سب سے زیادہ سخی تھے اور آپ ﷺ کی سخاوت اس وقت اور زیادہ بڑھ جاتی تھی جب جبرائیل علیہ السلام آپ ﷺ سے رمضان میں ملتے، جبرائیل علیہ السلام نبی کریم ﷺ سے رمضان شریف کی ہر رات میں ملتے یہاں تک کہ رمضان گزر جاتا۔ نبی کریم ﷺ جبرائیل علیہ السلام سے قرآن کا دور کرتے تھے، جب جبرائیل علیہ السلام آپ ﷺ سے ملنے لگتے تو آپ ﷺ چلتی ہوا سے بھی زیادہ بھلائی پہنچانے میں سخی ہو جایا کرتے تھے۔ (صحیح بخاری 1902). item.title: Hadith of the Day: Sahih al-Bukhari 1902 | Authentic Hadith in English
item.description: Narrated Narrated Ibn ‘Abbas: "The Prophet ﷺ was the most generous amongst the people, and he used to be more so in the month of Ramadan when Gabriel visited him, and Gabriel used to meet him on every night of Ramadan till the end of the month. The Prophet ﷺ used to recite the Holy Qur’an to Gabriel, and when Gabriel met him, he used to be more generous than a fast wind (which causes rain and welfare)" (Sahih al-Bukhari 1902, meaning). Authentic hadith of Prophet Muhammad ﷺ in English.

item.description: Narrated Narrated Sahl: "The Prophet ﷺ said, “There is a gate in Paradise called Ar-Raiyan, and those who observe fasts will enter through it on the Day of Resurrection and none except them will enter through it. item.description: Narrated Narrated Ibn ‘Umar: "The Prophet ﷺ observed the fast on the 10th of Muharram (‘Ashura), and ordered (Muslims) to fast on that day, but when the fasting of the month of Ramadan was prescribed, the fasting of the ‘Ashura’ was abandoned. ‘Abdullah did not use to fast on that day unless it coincided with his routine fasting by chance." (Sahih al-Bukhari 1892, meaning). Authentic hadith of Prophet Muhammad ﷺ in English.

item.description: Narrated Narrated Anas: "(The people of) Bani Salama intended to shift near the mosque (of the Prophet ﷺ) but Allah’s Messenger ﷺ disliked to see Medina vacated and said, “O the people of Bani Salama! Don’t you think that you will be rewarded for your footsteps which you take towards the mosque?” So, they stayed at their old places." (Sahih al-Bukhari 1887, meaning). Authentic hadith of Prophet Muhammad ﷺ in English.

item.description: Narrated Narrated Anas: "Whenever the Prophet ﷺ returned from a journey and observed the walls of Medina, he would make his Mount go fast, and if he was on an animal (i.e. a horse), he would make it gallop because of his love for Medina." (Sahih al-Bukhari 1886, meaning). Authentic hadith of Prophet Muhammad ﷺ in English.

item.description: Narrated Narrated Usama: "Once the Prophet ﷺ stood at the top of a (looked out from upon one) castle amongst the castles (or the high buildings) of Medina and said, “Do you see what I see?
